messages:
leah (People Ops): Heads-up 50 Mike tendered resignation this morning. Last day 2026-06-12. Need to confirm COBRA mailing, benefits end date, laptop return, and final payroll steps.

omar (Manager): Confirming 6/12. Can we schedule a short exit conversation 6/11 morning?

people-ops-bot: Proposed exit interview: 2026-06-11 09:30 PT. Leah to confirm.

leah (People Ops): Locked 6/11 09:30 PT. Mike, do you have a forwarding mailing address and preferred email for COBRA/benefits?

mike (Employee): Mail: 8 Willow Rd, Apt 2, Oakland, CA 94607. Email: mike.jensen+alum@gmail.com. Noted on interview.

benefits (Benefits): Thanks. COBRA packet will be generated on termination and sent within 14 days. Coverage end date will be 2026-06-12 (last day). If you have dependents, let us know for cost estimates.

mike (Employee): No dependents.

payroll (Payroll): Reminder: final pay requires approved timesheet + termination form by 2026-06-11 EOD to make the next payroll. PTO payout included in final payroll run.

it-support (IT): Proposed access schedule:
- 2026-06-12 08:00 PT: revoke prod & AWS console access
- 2026-06-12 17:00 PT: disable Okta and Google Workspace

omar (Manager): Please revoke deploy keys immediately at 08:00, but leave GitHub org membership until EOD so Mike can merge one small PR.

it-support (IT): Noted. For assets: laptop (MacBook Air), charger, and monitor. Please drop at HQ reception by 6/13 or request prepaid label.

mike (Employee): I'll drop at reception 6/12 lunchtime. If anything else needed, ping me.

leah (People Ops): Quick checklist I'm tracking:
- Timesheet & termination form (payroll)
- COBRA packet queued (benefits)
- Prod roles revoked + tokens rotated (IT/security)
- Asset return scanned (IT)
- Exit interview 6/11 09:30 PT (Zoom link sent)

people-ops-bot: Exit interview confirmed: 2026-06-11 09:30 PT. Zoom invite sent to participants.

leah (People Ops): Closing loop for now 50 will update when COBRA/termination paperwork is sent. Thanks everyone.
